title: Professional Demo Reel
description: Full demo reel showcasing character FX, rigging, cloth/hair simulation, muscle systems, and pipeline tools across multiple feature film productions.

title: Character FX Reel
description: Cloth, hair, and skin simulation work. Nucleus solver setups, nCloth/nHair configurations, and character deformation for feature animation.

title: UE-WeatherFX
description: Procedural weather material shaders for Unreal Engine 5. 10 HLSL shaders: rain drops/streaks, snow accumulation/sparkle/footprints, volumetric fog, heat haze, wind grass/flags. No textures — pure math. SM5 compatible.

title: ue-assetaudit
description: Fast Rust CLI for auditing Unreal Engine project assets. Naming conventions, size warnings, duplicate detection (SHA256, parallelized), broken references, empty folders. TOML config, JSON output for CI.

title: Bevy Aurora
description: Aurora borealis shader effect for the Bevy game engine. WGSL compute shaders for real-time northern lights simulation with procedural noise and color gradients.

title: Bevy Ahoy
description: 3D kinematic character controller for Bevy. Physics-based movement, water interaction, camera system. Clean ECS architecture for game prototyping.

title: Bevy Radiance Cascades
description: Radiance cascade global illumination implementation in Bevy. Real-time GI using cascaded radiance probes for dynamic lighting in game scenes.

title: Muscle Simulation Pipeline
description: End-to-end muscle rigging and simulation. From skeleton to muscle to skin deformation with Ziva Dynamics-style setups.

title: Cloth & Hair Simulation
description: Cloth and hair simulation tests. Nucleus solver capabilities for realistic fabric and hair dynamics.

title: Houdini RBD Dynamics
description: Rigid body destruction, debris, and dirt simulation in Houdini. Procedural setup for large-scale destruction effects.

title: Maya USD Author
description: Tool to author USD edits directly in Maya. PySide6 interface for stage editing, layer management, and property overrides.

title: Anvil
description: Rust-based package manager for VFX pipelines. Think Rez, but faster. YAML packages, dependency resolution, DCC launcher.
